visualizerParams.title: Code Refactor: From Three Loops to One
visualizerParams.problemDescription: Every start and end position is tried and the elements between them are added again each time. Replace the three nested loops with Kadane's single loop. The output must stay the same.

solution.explanation: The brute force version does about n cubed additions. Kadane's algorithm keeps the best run ending at the current index, so one pass of n steps is enough.
